paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 2.06, with a change of -16.26% compared to the prior close and -29.93% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of November 19, 2026.

There are 6 new news items in the last 24 hours, including a request from the Panhandle Groundwater Conservation District for more water use and conservation effort details from Fermi America, and a Texas Court ruling on Fermi's 70/30 boardroom maneuver. Toby Neugebauer, Fermi's co-founder and largest shareholder, plans to appeal the dismissal of his challenge to the 70% bylaw.

There have been recent filings, including 12 Form 144 notices of proposed sale by insiders, with 4 of these filed on November 20, 2026, and 1 filed on November 19, 2026. There are also 4 Form 4 filings and 1 proxy solicitation filing in the total of 25 filings.
